blind.description: A stylized low-poly/hand-painted mine cart. It features a rectangular open wooden hopper reinforced with dark riveted iron bands, mounted on a solid dark metal undercarriage with four wheels and iron coupling loops protruding from the front and back ends. Surfaces are clean, continuous, and solid.
blind.from_above: An open rectangular wooden box with brown floor planks visible inside, flanked by small metal hitch couplers protruding from the left and right sides.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall (roughly knee-high to the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3 feet long.
